---
title: facet-wrap
subtitle: "Wrap facets: one panel per level of a discrete variable."
category: Facets
since: 0.1.0
engine: markdown
---


Panels are arranged into a grid of `ncol` columns (or `nrow` rows when
`ncol` is `none`). Only shared scales are supported in v1.

## Usage

```typst
facet-wrap(
  var,
  ncol: none,
  nrow: none,
  scales: "fixed",
)
```


## Parameters

| Parameter | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `var` |  | Name of the discrete column whose levels drive the panels. |
| `ncol` | `none` | Number of columns in the panel grid, or `none` for automatic. |
| `nrow` | `none` | Number of rows in the panel grid, or `none` for automatic. |
| `scales` | `"fixed"` | Scale policy. Only `"fixed"` is supported in v1. |

## Returns

Facet dictionary consumed by [`plot`](../core/plot.qmd).

## Examples

```{typst}
//| output-filename: "/assets/typst-render/facet-wrap-1.svg"
//| width: 12cm
//| height: 7cm
#let d = ()
#for sp in ("a", "b", "c") {
  for i in range(0, 6) {
    d.push((sp: sp, x: i, y: i + calc.rem(i, 3)))
  }
}
#plot(
  data: d,
  mapping: aes(x: "x", y: "y"),
  layers: (geom-point(size: 2pt),),
  facet: facet-wrap("sp", ncol: 3),
)
```

## See also

[`facet-grid`](facet-grid.qmd), [`plot`](../core/plot.qmd).
